brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One Full hex base (piece) closed on top and bottom by full covers (cover top, cover bottom), with six side faces all closed: five by plug ports and one by the louvre port. The six caps are also on the base. check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port hex-port-louvre (port:0#0,0#0) sits on one side face as the vent. It is a single louvre port, the only vent on the enclosure. Airflow itself is not verified by the configurator, and no internal board is modelled, so I can't confirm how the board is ventilated.
No PCB or board part exists in the catalogue used here, and no board prop was added. The interior is empty apart from the base's cell.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed enclosure: a Full hex base with top and bottom covers, six caps, one louvre port as the vent and five plug ports closing the other side faces. The configurator reports no rule issues and a clear mesh check. I did not model the board itself, and the configurator does not check airflow, material, or waterproofing.
